features: ORGANIZE: Food storage containers for pantry, fridge, freezer, & kitchen cabinets
FUNCTIONAL: Home organization solution; use as craft, bathroom, or closet organizers and storage
HANDLES: Clear bins w/ soft grip handles are lightweight & transportable storage containers
STORE: Nestable bins, nest together when empty to maximize space for grocery organization and storage
SIZE: Find desired size whether used as veggie, baking supplies, jar, can, or condiment organizer
description: OGGI's Pantry & Refrigerator Organizer Bins are convenient, functional, and affordable food storage solutions. These are perfect for refrigerator, pantry, and kitchen cabinet organization. When groceries pile up it is easy for them to overcrowd your space, creating clutter and making products hard to find. These clear nestable storage bins are made to maximize and declutter your home. The sturdy reliable BPA-free containers are safe to use as refrigerator and freezer organizer bins. As a refrigerator organizer, easily declutter and arrange fruit, produce, condiments, drinks, and much more. Using the storage containers for organizing the pantry will leave your shelves looking social media worthy! The pantry bins are available in multiple sizes so finding the perfect fit for jars, cans, packets, baking supplies, and dry goods is a breeze. Transporting and lifting the bins is easy because of the built-in handles and lightweight design. They can be used to organize any room of the house including the closet, bathroom, and craft storage cabinet. Includes (1)14˝ x 9.75˝ x 2.75" organizer bin.
